**Finding submitted — LD: deviation (fallback redline proposed).**

- **What's wrong:** Section 14.2 loads a series of fixed termination payments onto PB: 300% of Development Costs on SFJ's termination for PB's material breach (p0750), on PB's at-will termination (p0755), on bankruptcy termination (p0764) and on PB-attributable safety terminations (p0769); 150% on Change of Control (p0765) and compliance breach (p0773); 100% on Adverse Patent Impact (p0779); and Development Costs plus 25% annual interest on a JSC-decision termination (p0781). These are Customer-payable liquidated amounts, and the breach-triggered multiples are cumulative with SFJ's preserved right to seek actual damages at law under 14.2.1 — walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Level chosen:** fallback, not preferred. An unconditional "no liquidated damages" prohibition would leave eight retained payment formulas contradicting it, so a single governing cap is the shortest clean cure.
- **Redline:** new Section 14.2.11 — "the sole liquidated amount payable by PB in connection with any termination of this Agreement is an early-termination fee not exceeding three months of Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ," covering all three fallback elements in one operation.
- **Not flagged:** Section 6.4 late-payment interest (ordinary default interest, rate redacted) and the Article 6 Approval/Buy-Out Payments (negotiated consideration, not liquidated amounts).
